Modal is where it all runs. A scheduled function wakes up every hour, so there's no server to keep running. Calling .map() spreads the claim checks across containers, so they run in parallel. A Modal Dict stores the results, a web endpoint serves the page at a public modal.run URL, and a Modal Secret keeps the xAI key out of the code. Between runs it scales to zero and bills by the second, which beats leaving a laptop script or a server on all day.
